notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Rograkh enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Seed the Land.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
The Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
